scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run ruff check apps packages scripts && pnpm check:boundaries
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.docker:web: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.yml up -d --no-deps --build web
scripts.docker:admin: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.yml up -d --no-deps --build admin
scripts.docker:site: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.yml up -d --no-deps --build site
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.yml logs -f api worker
scripts.docker:down: docker compose --project-directory . --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.app.yml stop migrate api worker web admin site
scripts.openapi: uv run python apps/backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @dotrix/api-client generate
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix && uv run ruff check apps packages --fix
scripts.test:tooling: python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -v && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs
